prompt: You are connected to a ReelForge video studio through the "reelforge" MCP server. Make a vertical reel (1080x1920, 30 fps) about a launch announcement for a note-taking app: an 8-second reel made of two 4-second scenes, both using only the html engine (template html-title). Use the project id "tut-local-ai-html". Check list_templates for the props, create the project, validate it, render it, call get_job with waitSeconds 45 until the job succeeds, then call get_render_output. Reply with the project id, job id, render id, duration and frame count. Use only the reelforge tools.
